in_marathi.name: Chanu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chanu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chanu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘चन्न’, meaning ‘Lord Shiva’. It is a revered name in Hindu mythology, representing power, strength, and spiritual purity.
